text_block_list.text:
With luck on her side, Matikanefukukitaru 
puts up a good fight in the Make Debut.

She declared that she would decide her 
next race by fortune-telling, and made her 
Trainer draw an omikuji.
Target race changed to Yayoi Sho.

As a result, it was decided that the next 
race to enter would be the Yayoi Sho.

Matikanefukukitaru's battle toward the 
spring barrier is about to begin!
Target race changed to Spring Stakes.

As a result, it was decided that the next 
race to enter would be the Spring Stakes.

Matikanefukukitaru's battle toward the 
spring barrier is about to begin!
Target race changed to Mainichi Hai.

As a result, it was decided that the next 
race to enter would be the Mainichi Hai.

Matikanefukukitaru's battle toward the 
spring barrier is about to begin!
